compound.name: carnosol
compound.one_liner: Oxidation product of carnosic acid formed after harvest and on drying; a major rosemary contact allergen.

biosynthesis.note: Formed non-enzymatically from carnosic acid by oxidation [43].

processing_stability.note: Oxidative 'artefact' of carnosic acid formed after harvest and in leaves on drying [43].

safety_flags.detail: Identified by EMA as a major allergen in rosemary contact dermatitis.
safety_flags.source_citation: EMA/HMPC assessment report on rosemary, Rev. 1 (2024)

compound.teaching_note: Partly an artefact: much of the carnosol in a jar of dried herb was made after picking [43].
gaps: No human evidence for the isolated compound found in this pass.
